title: Kagamine Len — Swimming In Cider〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
There you are.
Are you practicing by yourself right now, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Ah, yes...
But I'm about to take a break.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, that's perfect!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wanna have some cider while you do?
Saki and the others brought over more FizzYum Cider.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. Then, I think I'll have some.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I've got grape and lemon. Which do you want? I've had both before, so pick whichever one you like.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, grape...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Alright, lemon for me.
Bottoms up.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Mmm... I always have fun whenever I drink soda. I really like how it pops and fizzes in my mouth.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I remember us all being surprised by that the first time we had some.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Still, this company asked Ichika and the girls to do a collaboration with them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It is pretty incredible.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, but I'm not sure I've really gotten a good grasp of just how incredible it is.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They talked about how their commercial is going to be aired on TV, but I don't have an idea of what that's going to be like, you know?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's understandable since it's not a subject we're familiar with...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Speaking of which, I sort of felt the same way when they told us how their debut song has become a big hit.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me too. When they told us that the Miku version got like eight million views, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. It was mostly the way they spoke that clued me in to how remarkable an achievement it was...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I know what you mean. None of us really knew at first what it meant for something to “go viral”.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But it became pretty obvious after we heard that tons of people were talking about their song.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Someone would listen to it, think it's good and recommend it to others. Rinse and repeat.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: In turn, their song brings people together.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Which is one of the big things they've set out to do as Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have to think Ichika's feeling particularly happy right now, since the song they wrote and had Miku sing is bringing all these people together...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Though, she actually seemed more surprised by how big it's become.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ichika and Saki are amazing for writing a song like that, but so is the power of music...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Some things can only be expressed through music.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: People who aren't very good at communicating how they feel, like me, are voiceless without music...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I wouldn't say you're entirely voiceless...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now I feel like playing something...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But you just started taking a break.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Actually, I also feel like playing something now...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: How about a session...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! But lemme finish my cider first, okay?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Mmm...
Man, this cider's good!
